author_or_org: Yuhan Zhang, Zhiyuan Guo, Ziheng Zeng, Wei Wang, Wentao Wu, Lijie Xu

claims.question: q3
claims.claim: Mandol is proposed as an agglomerative memory system that consolidates fragmented memory representations and storage into a unified memory-native architecture.
claims.quote: We propose Mandol, an agglomerative memory system that consolidates fragmented memory representations and storage into a unified memory-native architecture.

claims.question: q2
claims.claim: Existing agent memory systems rely on heterogeneous vector and graph databases, which fragment memory information and cause high cross-database I/O latency.
claims.quote: Existing agent memory systems rely on heterogeneous vector and graph databases, which fragment memory information and cause high cross-database I/O latency.

claims.question: q4
claims.claim: Common RAG-style retrieval methods tend to introduce noise, miss correlated clues, and lack token budget control, degrading LLM accuracy and efficiency.
claims.quote: For retrieval, common RAG-style methods tend to introduce noise, miss correlated clues, and lack token budget control, degrading LLM accuracy and efficiency.

claims.question: q3
claims.claim: Mandol uses a hierarchical memory model with a basic layer for raw memory information and a high-level abstract layer that agglomerates basic memories into traceable abstract memories, both represented as structured semantic graphs.
claims.quote: Its core components include: (1) a hierarchical memory model that organizes memory into a basic layer representing raw memory information and a high-level abstract layer that agglomerates basic memories into traceable abstract memories, both uniformly represented as structured semantic graphs;

claims.question: q2
claims.claim: Mandol uses an agglomerative semantic data structure combining SemanticMap and SemanticGraph that natively fuses key-value, vector, and graph structures and provides unified hybrid retrieval operators to eliminate cross-database I/O.
claims.quote: (2) an agglomerative semantic data structure combining SemanticMap and SemanticGraph, which natively fuses key-value, vector, and graph structures and provides unified hybrid retrieval operators to eliminate cross-database I/O;

claims.question: q3
claims.claim: Mandol includes a quantitative query mechanism with query-adaptive routing, quantitative denoising and conflict resolution, and token-constrained context generation, all without involving LLMs during retrieval.
claims.quote: (3) a quantitative query mechanism with query-adaptive routing, quantitative denoising and conflict resolution, and token-constrained context generation, all without involving LLMs during retrieval.

claims.question: q3
claims.claim: Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval show that Mandol achieves the best overall accuracy among representative agent memory systems.
claims.quote: Experiments on two widely used long-term conversation benchmarks, LoCoMo and LongMemEval, show that Mandol achieves the best overall accuracy among representative agent memory systems.

claims.question: q3
claims.claim: Mandol obtains a 5.4x retrieval speedup and a 4.8x insertion speedup under 10 QPS concurrent load while maintaining low latency on consumer-grade hardware.
claims.quote: For performance comparison, Mandol also obtains a 5.4x retrieval speedup and a 4.8x insertion speedup under 10 QPS concurrent load, while still maintaining low latency on consumer-grade hardware.
